raw_notice_text:
CENTRAL ARMED POLICE FORCES - RECRUITMENT CELL
Notification Reference: CAPF-AC-2026-SPEC
Assistant Commandants Examination 2026

1. Essential Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
2. Age Limits & Relaxations:

- Base Age Boundary: 20 to 25 years on 01 August 2026.

- OBC Candidates: 3 years upper age relaxation (up to 28 years).

- SC / ST Candidates: 5 years upper age relaxation (up to 30 years).

- Civilian Central Government Servants: 5 years age relaxation.

3. Application Fee: Rs. 200 (Female and SC/ST candidates are totally exempted).
4. Last Date for Online Registration: 08 May 2026 (18:00 Hours).
5. Portal Link: https://upsc.gov.in/capf2026
